newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 18.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 18. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

An Indonesian Fokker F-27 aircraft operated by Sempati Air crashed near the hill city of Bandung killing 27 people, including the five crew, and injuring at least 23 others as it tried to make an emergency landing at an air force base.
Donor governments and international lending agencies led by Japan and the World Bank pledged in Tokyo to allocate Indonesia $5.3 billion in aid for the year 1997/98.
President Suharto told the nation to be watchful of religious harmony as part of a message on the anniversary of the birth of the Prophet Muhammad.
Businessmen Sudwikatmono and Soetjipto Nagaria have formed a joint venture company to develop a town centre in Kelapa Gading Permai in north Jakarta with a total investment of $600 million.
